title: Exhibit A: Screenshot Markup for Mac, Free
description: Exhibit A is a free Mac menu bar screenshot tool: mark up a capture with single keys, a spoken sentence, or one command from an agent. For macOS 14 or later.
og_title: Exhibit A: mark up a screenshot in a few keystrokes
og_description: Seven marks on seven keys, plain-spoken instructions, and an exhibit command and MCP server for agents. Secrets blur for good. Free for macOS 14 or later.

title: Privacy: What Exhibit A Keeps and Sends
description: Exhibit A keeps captures on your Mac for 30 days, exports flat images, blurs secrets before agents see them, and has no telemetry, analytics or account.
og_description: Captures stay on your Mac, exports are flat pixels, and agents get secrets blurred. No telemetry, no analytics, no account.
